name: Glass rating prompt
oneLiner: an in-app rating sheet on glass with the brand icon, a question and five empty stars: a pointer taps the last star and they fill one by one with a pop, a glint and a gold ring, Submit lights and is pressed, the button row folds away, the icon flips over into a green check and the sheet turns to a thank-you as the stars wave
say: when the speaker asks for a rating or says users rated it ('leave it five stars', 'they rate it straight away'): the stars fill on 'five stars', the check lands on 'thanks' or the result; it shows the act of rating, review-stars shows the score
